scope: HB compact-9 X Settle B8/L256 BF16 complete AdamW training; old serial, batch4, new batch4+prefix+reception checkpoint, and bounded A-D Transformer candidates. No inference/continuation/FP32/other-size qualification is inferred.

boundaries.normal: Two warmup updates then five sequential fresh-prefill complete training samples; zero_grad, preparation/packing, forward, required Timed flush (not executed for these Settle models), readout/loss, backward, AdamW foreach, sync/scalar and release. Excludes construction, input transfer, warmup, CPU anchor/restore/hash, audits, profiling, checkpoint IO.
boundaries.diagnostic_anchor: Each diagnostic restores model, optimizer, gradients, RNG to the exact first normal-sample start; input hashes are recorded. Does not freeze later normal updates. Different Tide implementations have different post-warmup anchors and actual activity.
boundaries.stages: Nested synchronized wall observations, not kernel times. Exclusive rows partition only intrusive scope; inclusive parents and children overlap. Trace/saved/work/runtime are separate passes.
boundaries.normal_memory: Peak allocated resets immediately before normal samples and is read before post-normal audits. Includes persistent parameters/gradients/optimizer/input; reserved cache may survive warmup.
boundaries.saved_memory: Outer saved_tensors_hooks peak of simultaneous unique storages, by innermost save site. Stage rows overlap aliases and peak times. Not exclusive removable activations or allocator peak. Additional excludes original parameter storages only, so input and cast-weight copies remain. Checkpoint nested hooks can hide recomputed saves.
boundaries.runtime: TorchDispatch complete-training calls/shapes/dtype/device. Logical output materialization bytes are not measured bus traffic. Native opaque operations may contain multiple kernels.
boundaries.old_ssd: d5c7f30b ssd.scan merges matrix-state and K=1 short/long summaries. New ae247dee separately labels ssd.matrix and ssd.summary.prefix. Do not attribute the entire old ssd.scan time to summaries.
boundaries.device_resource: Cooperative queue exclusive allocation; external jobs and host load not controlled. Different physical devices and times remain separate observations.
